title: neubeckia decora
intro: Neubeckia decora, commonly known as the New Zealand tea tree, is a type of plant native to New Zealand and Australia. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Neubeckia decora include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, and also exhibit antioxidant activity that can help to protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Neubeckia decora include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
